prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / production animation sprite asset.
Create a SQUARE sprite atlas with a perfectly regular 3 by 3 grid, ideally 2048 by 2048. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Exactly nine full-body character cutouts, one centered within each equal square cell, ample transparent gutter around every pose. No device, frame, screen, scenery, writing, grid lines, titles, labels, props, UI, detached parts, drop shadow or ground plane.
Input image is a CHARACTER IDENTITY reference, not a composition to retain. Extract its living creature visually and reproduce that exact face, material, coloring and anatomy in clean front-facing production-quality sprites. Remove the hardware and every word. Preserve the approved creature rather than redesigning it.
These nine poses will be sliced into real animation assets for a 720x720 physical screen. CONSISTENCY IS CRITICAL: same character proportions, camera, lighting, scale, material, head size, body position and baseline across all nine cells. All body parts fully inside each cell with 12 percent empty margin. Body centers line up within cells and feet rest on the same baseline. Diffuse beautiful gentle lighting, no cast shadows outside the creature, no motion blur. Expressions subtle and soulful.
Exact row-major pose order:
Row 1 left: CALM, front facing, relaxed posture, eyes open, tiny friendly smile.
Row 1 center: CALM BLINK, identical body and pose to the previous cell, just eyelids softly closed.
Row 1 right: LISTENING, slight attentive head tilt, body subtly leaning toward viewer, eyes making warm direct contact.
Row 2 left: LISTENING BLINK, exact same body and pose as row 1 right but eyelids softly closed.
Row 2 center: THINKING, head slightly turned and eyes looking up toward one side, one hand/paw/tentacle thoughtfully under the chin.
Row 2 right: THINKING BLINK, identical body and pose to row 2 center, only eyelids softly closed.
Row 3 left: HAPPY, delighted warm smile, eyes happily curved, arms/tentacles gently lifted in a little celebration.
Row 3 center: SLEEPY, curled comfortably and compactly at the same bottom baseline, peacefully closed eyes; entire body still within the cell.
Row 3 right: SURPRISED, wide curious eyes, tiny open mouth, limbs lifted slightly; charming rather than frightened.
This is a clean professional RGBA sprite sheet, NOT a mood board or storyboard. Exactly 3 columns and 3 rows, evenly sized cells, transparent gutters, no accidental extra sprites. Small details such as fingers/tentacles remain coherent.
Character: The lavender octopus Tim: a large smooth purple head, eight curling tentacles, cream eyes with dark pupils, small dark mouth, subtle blush. Preserve the velvety sculpted material from the reference. No artificial bloom.
